message.reasoning:
We need to produce test cases for exception scenarios not covered. Identify all possible exception scenarios in getInstance method.

Method:

public static JsonSchemaFactory getInstance(SpecVersion.VersionFlag versionFlag, Consumer<JsonSchemaFactory.Builder> customizer) {
    JsonSchemaVersion jsonSchemaVersion = checkVersion(versionFlag);
    JsonMetaSchema metaSchema = jsonSchemaVersion.getInstance();
    JsonSchemaFactory.Builder builder = builder().defaultMetaSchemaURI(metaSchema.getUri()).addMetaSchema(metaSchema);
    if (customizer != null) {
        customizer.accept(builder);
    }
    return builder.build();
}

Potential exceptions:

- versionFlag null => NullPointerException (already covered)
- checkVersion may throw IllegalArgumentException for unsupported versionFlag (already covered)
- jsonSchemaVersion.getInstance() could throw something? Probably not.
- builder().defaultMetaSchemaURI(metaSchema.getUri()) may throw NullPointerException if metaSchema.getUri() null? But built-in meta schema should not be null.
- customizer.accept(builder) could throw RuntimeException if customizer itself throws. Need test for customizer throwing exception.
- builder.build() could throw IllegalStateException if required fields missing? Possibly if defaultMetaSchemaURI not set or meta schema missing? But builder always has them before customizer. However customizer could nullify something? Builder methods don't have null checks? For example builder.defaultMetaSchemaURI(null) could set defaultMetaSchemaURI to null; then later build may cause NullPointerException later when used. But builder.build just passes values to JsonSchemaFactory constructor; maybe null is allowed? Not sure. But we can test that passing a customizer that sets defaultMetaSchemaURI to null leads to NPE when later using factory? But exception may not be thrown at getInstance.

Better to focus on exceptions directly thrown in getInstance: NullPointerException for null versionFlag, IllegalArgumentException for unsupported versionFlag, and any exception thrown by customizer (e.g., RuntimeException). Also maybe customizer is null but builder is null? No.

Thus we need test cases for customizer that throws checked exception? Consumer can't throw checked. So runtime.

Test case: customizer throws NullPointerException intentionally.

Test case: customizer throws IllegalArgumentException.

Test case: customizer modifies builder in a way that leads to IllegalStateException during build (if builder.validate). Need to inspect Builder.build: returns new JsonSchemaFactory(jsonMapper, yamlMapper, defaultMetaSchemaURI, schemaLoadersBuilder, schemaMappersBuilder, jsonMetaSchemas, enableUriSchemaCache); no validation, so likely no exception.

Thus only customizer exception.

Also test for versionFlag being a valid enum but checkVersion returns null? Possibly checkVersion could return null leading to NPE when calling getInstance on null. So test for versionFlag that is supported but checkVersion returns null (unlikely). Not needed.

Thus we add test group "customizer throws exception". Also maybe test for customizer that sets builder to null? Not possible.
